content: We analyze the distribution of syntactic categories and word fertility on the same language pairs with reverse directions, i.e., English$\Rightarrow $Chinese, French$\Rightarrow $English, and Japanese$\Rightarrow $English. The results are shown in Table TABREF43 and Table TABREF44 respectively, where we observe similar findings as before. We use the Stanford POS tagger to parse the English and French input sentences, and use the Kytea to parse the Japanese input sentences.
